disposition: POSITIVE_RESOURCE_USE_INAPPLICABLE; PUBLIC VALIDATION COVERAGE STILL OPEN
classification_basis: Microsoft 10Level9 ID3D11Device reference states CreateTexture1D is unsupported on every 9.* level. Current HAL reports downlevel texture_1d=false and core rejects D1 before HAL (wgpu-hal/src/dx11/FL9_1_PLAN.md; wgpu-core/src/device/resource.rs). This justifies no positive D1 operation; retain explicit negative public validation tests.
source_evidence: cts/src/webgpu/api/operation/command_buffer/image_copy.spec.ts and cts/src/webgpu/api/validation/image_copy/* test D1; current wgpu-hal/src/dx11/FL9_1_PLAN.md reports DownlevelLimits.texture_1d=false; core resource.rs rejects D1 before HAL.

disposition: 12 SINGLE-LAYER SUBCASES PHYSICALLY PASS; MIXED UPSTREAM PARENT MUST REMAIN EXCLUDED UNTIL CAPABILITY-AWARE SPLIT
classification_basis: Unmodified mixed selector failed because CTS generates 2D array subcases unsupported by this adapter (unexpected TEXTURE_2D_ARRAYS validation error plus bad array pixels). The controlled single-layer predicate removed only dimension=2d cases with size[2]>1; this exact selector then passed all 4 one-layer subcases. FL9_1 CreateTexture2D contract allows noncube ArraySize=1 only. This demonstrates a safe applicability split but does not make the unchanged upstream mixed parent pass.
source_evidence: CTS source cts/src/webgpu/api/operation/command_buffer/image_copy.spec.ts undefined_params fixes rgba8unorm; control changes only the single-layer predicate. tests.json#followup.targeted_cts records unmodified exit=1, control exit=0, 12 pass total across 3 selectors, exact FL9_1 hardware.
prior_run_result: exit=1 mixed selector; failing subcases require unsupported 2D arrays
